question: Which house is considered as lower house in State Legislature?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Vidhan Sabha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Vidhan Sabha** is considered the **lower house** in the State Legislature of India.
 
• It is also known as the **Legislative Assembly**.
 
• The members of the Vidhan Sabha are directly elected by the **people of the state**.
